UK Chancellor Unveils Energy Support and Wind Farm Tax Measures

UK Chancellor John Healey has announced a new energy support package for households, including a £100 one-off payment, loans for low-carbon upgrades, and an end to standing charges. Healey stated this initiative aims to reduce energy costs in line with Europe, framing it as a response to "global economic storms." Concurrently, Healey has introduced tax measures targeting wind farms.
